(b) P-WEBMCP-TOOL 714/2147 will REPRODUCE falsification at f=10 honest per_hit=/RAG 1.005>0.85 and rho 0.363<0.60 (bounded, not flipped), but may achieve M_total_f10 Pareto saving (1104 vs 3663 tokens) or flip to per_hit <=0.85 only at f=100 amortized (compile 8 vs 80, per_hit 48.2/54.7=0.88>0.85 prior exploratory still failing but closer) or on Docker BrowserGym 2000-node real gpt-4o-mini tokens/browser/latency with rho_proxy_real>=0.5 correlation to proxy; if both exploratory still >0.85 and rho_proxy_real<0.5, WebMCP file-proxy economics is bounded REJECTED and Product PARKs residual-novelty/WebMCP f=10 and ships Stagehand+TTL gating as interim lever; if f=100 or Docker flips, WebMCP remains Pareto-viable for compilation leverage but Stagehand gating still ships as low-overhead baseline.
